# The Bartlett Review

> UCL's Bartlett Faculty research hub exploring critical challenges in the built environment, from housing and urban planning to sustainability, health equity, and governance.

The Bartlett Review showcases interdisciplinary research from UCL's Bartlett Faculty of the Built Environment, featuring expert perspectives on London and UK-wide issues including housing crises, sustainable transport, environmental governance, and community engagement. The site combines long-form articles, podcasts, and research insights from leading academics tackling contemporary urban challenges.

## Key Topics

- housing-crisis
- urban-planning
- sustainability
- built-environment
- London

## Featured Podcasts

- [Podcast: How to get Britain building](https://bartlett-review.ucl.ac.uk/podcast-how-to-get-britain-building/index.html): Podcast on UK housing crisis with Raco, Foye, and Hudson
- [Podcast: Tackling the UK Housing Crisis](https://bartlett-review.ucl.ac.uk/podcast-tackling-the-uk-housing-crisis/index.html): Podcast with Parikh and Milcheva on UK housing shortage solutions
- [Podcast: Roadkill](https://bartlett-review.ucl.ac.uk/podcast-roadkill/index.html): Podcast with Dame Henrietta Moore on car culture and sustainable living
- [Podcast: Cities in Flux: Rethinking Temporary Urbanism and Urban Adaptability](https://bartlett-review.ucl.ac.uk/podcast-cities-in-flux-rethinking-temporary-urbanism-and-urban-adaptability/index.html): Lauren Andres on urban adaptability and temporary urbanism resilience
- [Podcast: Recognising Slavery's History in City Regeneration](https://bartlett-review.ucl.ac.uk/podcast-recognising-slaverys-history-in-city-regeneration/index.html): Fouseki and Paul on slavery heritage in urban regeneration projects
- [Podcast: Tomorrow's Cities - AI in Urban Planning](https://bartlett-review.ucl.ac.uk/podcast-tomorrows-cities-ai-in-urban-planning/index.html): Raco and Andres on AI potential and ethics in urban planning
- [Podcast: The AI Blueprint for the Construction Industry](https://bartlett-review.ucl.ac.uk/podcast-the-ai-blueprint-for-the-construction-industry/index.html): Parikh on AI adoption and industry transformation in construction

## Housing & Health

- [Uncovering the health inequalities in London housing](https://bartlett-review.ucl.ac.uk/uncovering-the-health-inequalities-in-london-housing/index.html): Dr Phil Symonds on housing health inequalities and environmental design
- [Tackling moisture balance for healthier housing in London](https://bartlett-review.ucl.ac.uk/tackling-moisture-balance-for-healthier-housing-in-london/index.html): IEDE research on mold prevention and retrofit challenges in housing
- [How human behaviour is the key to tackling indoor air pollution](https://bartlett-review.ucl.ac.uk/how-human-behaviour-is-the-key-to-tackling-indoor-air-pollution/index.html): Samuel Stamp on ventilation behavior and London air quality research

## Urban Sustainability & Transport

- [Why don't we have sustainable transport in London?](https://bartlett-review.ucl.ac.uk/why-dont-we-have-sustainable-transport-in-london/index.html): Robin Hickman on London transport transition barriers and policy
- [Can London's drivers go electric?](https://bartlett-review.ucl.ac.uk/can-londons-drivers-go-electric/index.html): Andrew Roberts on EV charging infrastructure and equity in London
- [When governance fails the planet](https://bartlett-review.ucl.ac.uk/when-governance-fails-the-planet/index.html): Catalina Turcu on environmental governance and climate negotiations

## London Urban Form & Public Spaces

- [Why we need a longer view of London's high streets](https://bartlett-review.ucl.ac.uk/why-we-need-a-longer-view-of-londons-high-streets/index.html): Laura Vaughan on London high street evolution and urban form analysis
- [Making better use of London's green spaces](https://bartlett-review.ucl.ac.uk/making-better-use-of-londons-green-spaces/index.html): Zimmermann and Moore on Thamesmead green space usage and planning
- [Sharing the untold stories of London](https://bartlett-review.ucl.ac.uk/sharing-the-untold-stories-of-london/index.html): Survey of London project on Bloomsbury heritage and city development

## Community Engagement & Food Systems

- [Training citizens to shape their own communities and cities](https://bartlett-review.ucl.ac.uk/training-citizens-to-shape-their-own-communities-and-cities/index.html): Joseph Cook on UCL Citizen Science Academy and community engagement
- [Fairer ways to feed the UK](https://bartlett-review.ucl.ac.uk/fairer-ways-to-feed-the-uk/index.html): Dr Hanna Baumann on citizen science and communal dining facilities
